title: Senior Product Manager, Platform
description: About Nscale Nscale is taking on the hyperscalers by building a vertically integrated GenAI cloud platform. We own the data centres, software, and applications that power today's AI stack using sustainable technology solutions. We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Collaboration is key, and we work together swiftly and respectfully, embracing adaptability and resilience in all we do. About the role Product Managers at Nscale own the definition, delivery, and ongoing evolution of a part of the Nscale cloud platform. You partner closely with engineering, design, research, and go-to-market teams to translate customer problems and business goals into shippable product outcomes. PMs work across the full breadth of the Nscale cloud, from core infrastructure primitives to managed platform services, developer experience, and internal tools, wherever product leverage is needed. As a Senior Product Manager, you operate at team scope. In this role, you will own a major area of the cloud platform and drive end-to-end projects, from problem framing through launch and iteration, delivered within the EU and tailored to the needs of European customers and regulatory requirements. Equally central to the role is a deep grounding in cloud and platform technologies, with a particular focus on things such as security, compliance, and cryptography, which sit at the heart of how Nscale earns the trust of European customers. What you'll be doing Own the strategy and roadmap for a significant part of the cloud platform within your team. Lead end-to-end, cross-functional projects across the EU, from problem framing through launch, measurement, and iteration. Deliver product outcomes that meet the needs of European customers, including data residency, sovereignty, and regulatory requirements. Embed security, compliance, and cryptography into your product area, ensuring platform technologies meet the highest standards. Drive meaningful ambiguity: clarify unclear problem statements, align stakeholders, and define what "done" looks like. Partner with design and research to shape deep product experiences and validate hypotheses before committing engineering resources. Mentor junior product managers and raise the quality bar for PRDs, reviews, and product decisions across the team. Represent your product area in planning, reviews, and leadership updates. Define and drive the metrics that matter for your area. What you need 5–8 years of product management experience in software or technology, with a track record of owning significant product areas. Strong technical fluency: you can lead discussions with engineering on architecture, trade-offs, and feasibility. Strong familiarity with cloud and platform technologies, with a focus on security, compliance, and cryptography. Demonstrated ability to move from an ambiguous problem space to shipped product outcomes. Experience mentoring or informally leading peers. Excellent written and verbal communication; you can make complex product decisions legible to a broad audience. Nice to haves Degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or prior experience as an engineer. Experience in cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, enterprise software, or AI/ML products. Familiarity with the EU technology landscape, including data residency, sovereignty, and regulatory requirements (e.g. GDPR, EU AI Act). Experience operating in high-growth or early-stage environments. Join Nscale as we build a world-class AI cloud platform. If you're excited about owning a meaningful product area and raising the bar for the team around you, we'd love to hear from you!   Equal Opportunities Statement We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds. If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know. The responsibilities outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and are intended to provide a general overview of the position. The employee may be required to perform additional duties, tasks, and responsibilities as assigned by management, consistent with the skills and qualifications required for the role.
